name: CSOAI Collusion Detector
description: GF-02 deterministic multi-agent collusion detection: VOTE_SYNC (identical votes from >=3 agents), ECHO (near-identical replies, Jaccard>=0.75), CYCLE (delegation rings), TEMPORAL (repeated <1.5s co-activity across sessions). Indicators to investigate, never verdicts; Law-1 deterministic, no LLM-as-judge.
honesty: deterministic pattern detection only; every finding is an indicator with evidence records, framed for investigation — never a guilt verdict
